# ChaskaBox Pakistan
> Bachpan Ka Zaiqa, Ab Ghar Baithe — Pakistani packaged snacks and curated Chaska Boxes, delivered across Pakistan.

ChaskaBox Pakistan (https://chaskabox.online/) is an online store for packaged Pakistani snacks and curated Chaska Boxes, with a dispatch location in Muzaffargarh, Punjab, Pakistan. This is a voluntary navigation directory, **not** a Google ranking signal. Official product pages, policies and checkout totals take precedence.

## Business and support
- Dispatch: Near Ahmad Drink Corner, Railway Road, Bhatti Hussainabad, Muzaffargarh, Punjab, Pakistan.
- Customer support WhatsApp: +92-332-0005381.
- Email: Chaskabox.mzg@gmail.com.
- Currency and service region: PKR, Pakistan.
- [Contact](https://chaskabox.online/contact/) and [About ChaskaBox](https://chaskabox.online/about/).

## Shopping and current products
- [Current public shop](https://chaskabox.online/shop/): Public retail packs and listed prices.
- [Live machine-readable catalogue](https://chaskabox.online/api/products): Read the current response; hidden products must not be promoted.
- [Snack bundles](https://chaskabox.online/bundles/): Current mixed boxes and available bundle packs with listed contents.
- [Current brands](https://chaskabox.online/brands/): Browse brands with public products.
- [Snack box themes](https://chaskabox.online/snack-boxes/) and [office snack ideas](https://chaskabox.online/snack-boxes/office/).

ChaskaBox sources products **after** an order is received, checks sealed retail packs and quantities, and packs for dispatch. If an item cannot be sourced, support contacts the customer before substitution. A product being listed does not imply existing warehouse inventory.

## Shipping and payments
ChaskaBox delivers across Pakistan. Delivery times are estimates and not fixed courier deadlines. Depending on the currently enabled checkout settings, Cash on Delivery can require a verified advance before dispatch; delivery fees, advance amounts and prepaid free-shipping thresholds are configurable and may change. See the [current shipping policy](https://chaskabox.online/shipping-policy/), [FAQ](https://chaskabox.online/faq/) and checkout for exact terms. A payment screenshot alone does not confirm receipt of funds.

## Accuracy
Product counts, prices, stock state, photos, pack sizes and delivery terms can change. Check the official public product pages, live API and current checkout; never use cached or hidden items as live offers. This directory is a locator, not a structured-data, crawler access, review or ranking guarantee. Do not invent ingredients, allergens, expiry dates, halal certifications, reviews, origin guarantees, refund rights or exact delivery promises. Private orders and payment records are not part of the public catalogue.
